body:
PR #2731 (branch claude/bug-1982) is ready for review. It covers BUG-1982 and BUG-1985; the worktree is removed so the reviewer can check out the branch.

BUG-1985 (A+B ruling):
- A: no submodule recursion (diff.ignoreSubmodules=dirty) for linked worktrees and for repos carrying the contained marker.
- B: a gitlink with no .gitmodules entry keeps the tree; salvage refuses it.
- All 15 raw host `git status` sites now go through host_git_command, with a guard test.
- The planted-filter-driver test is mutation-checked.

BUG-1982:
- #2541's deny of all of <main>/.git already blocks the metadata redirect. The PR adds a real-sandbox test and the OVERVIEW doc.
- The linked-worktree commit half of AC2 belongs to BUG-2169 (seat clone). The test proves a contained session can commit in a seat clone.

Gates:
- check-ci-fast: 30/30 passed.
- check-ci-compile: passed.
- test-touched: 9081 passed, 1 failed. advisor_code_gate::worktree_lease_role_takes_precedence_over_roster_role passes when run alone; it looks like a parallel-run flake.

Statuses left as they were; completion is your call. Security (STRICT): the operator merges.
subject: BUG-1982/BUG-1985: PR #2731 ready for STRICT review
